fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Yemen requires your passport to expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Yemen exige que tu pasaporte venza al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Yemen, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: A visa is required to enter Yemen.
entry.es: Se necesita visa para entrar a Yemen.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to enter Yemen.

entry.en: Visitors staying more than 14 days must register their passport with Yemen's immigration authorities after arrival.
entry.es: Quien permanezca más de 14 días debe registrar su pasaporte ante las autoridades de inmigración de Yemen tras llegar.
entry.quote: If you visit Yemen for more than 14 days, you must register your passport with the Yemen immigration authorities after you arrive.

entry.en: Importing or exporting local currency is illegal, and foreign currency above 3,000 US dollars must be declared.
entry.es: Importar o exportar moneda local es ilegal y la moneda extranjera superior a 3.000 dólares debe declararse.
entry.quote: Import and export of local currency is illegal. There are no restrictions on the import of foreign currencies, but you must declare amounts higher than 3,000 US dollars.

entry.en: Citizens of most countries, with the possible exception of Gulf Co-operation Council members, must obtain visas in advance.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos de la mayoría de los países, con posible excepción de los miembros del Consejo de Cooperación del Golfo, deben obtener la visa con antelación.
entry.quote: Citizens of most countries (with the possible exception of Gulf Co-operation Council members) must obtain visas in advance.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to the whole of Yemen due to unpredictable security conditions.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a todo Yemen debido a las condiciones de seguridad impredecibles.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the whole of the Yemen due to the unpredictable security conditions.

safety.en: There is a very high and constant threat of kidnap across Yemen.
safety.es: Existe una amenaza muy alta y constante de secuestro en todo Yemen.
safety.quote: There is a very high and constant threat of kidnap across Yemen.

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Yemen.
safety.es: Es muy probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Yemen.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Yemen.

safety.en: The risk of crime such as carjacking, robbery or extortion is widespread throughout Yemen.
safety.es: El riesgo de delitos como robo de vehículos, atracos o extorsión es generalizado en todo el país.
safety.quote: The risk of crime, such as carjacking, robbery or extortion, is widespread throughout the country.

safety.en: Reports of arbitrary arrests and enforced disappearances raise concerns.
safety.es: Los informes de detenciones arbitrarias y desapariciones forzadas generan preocupación.
safety.quote: Reports of arbitrary arrests and enforced disappearances raise concerns.

safety.en: Support for British people in Yemen is severely limited.
safety.es: El apoyo a los ciudadanos británicos en Yemen es muy limitado.
safety.quote: Support for British people is severely limited in Yemen.

health.en: Medical facilities in Yemen are poor, particularly away from the main towns and cities.
health.es: Los centros médicos en Yemen son deficientes, sobre todo lejos de las principales ciudades.
health.quote: Medical facilities, particularly away from the main towns and cities, are poor.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Yemen.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Yemen.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Yemen.

health.en: Tap water should be avoided and bottled water is recommended.
health.es: Se debe evitar el agua del grifo y se recomienda el agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water should be avoided. To stay safe, it is recommended to stick to the bottled variety.

health.en: Malaria is present in low-lying areas along the Red Sea.
health.es: Hay malaria en las zonas bajas a lo largo del Mar Rojo.
health.quote: Malaria is present in low-lying areas along the Red Sea.

health.en: Rabid dogs are common in Yemen.
health.es: Los perros rabiosos son comunes en Yemen.
health.quote: Rabid dogs are common in Yemen.

help.en: Emergency services in Yemen have severely limited capacity and are highly unreliable because of the conflict.
help.es: Por el conflicto, los servicios de emergencia en Yemen tienen una capacidad muy limitada y son poco fiables.
help.quote: As a result of the conflict, emergency services in Yemen have severely limited capacity and are highly unreliable.

help.en: The listed numbers are 191 for ambulance and fire, and 199 or 194 for police.
help.es: Los números indicados son 191 para ambulancia y bomberos, y 199 o 194 para la policía.

help.en: British Embassy services in Sana'a are suspended and all diplomatic and consular staff have been withdrawn.
help.es: Los servicios de la Embajada Británica en Saná están suspendidos y todo el personal diplomático y consular se ha retirado.
help.quote: British Embassy services in Sana’a are suspended, and all diplomatic and consular staff have been withdrawn.

getting_in.en: As of 2023, most flights to Yemen are suspended.
getting_in.es: Desde 2023, la mayoría de los vuelos a Yemen están suspendidos.
getting_in.quote: As of 2023, most flights to Yemen are suspended.

getting_in.en: As of July 2024, Sanaa Airport has flights from Amman, Mumbai and Cairo.
getting_in.es: En julio de 2024, el aeropuerto de Saná tenía vuelos desde Amán, Bombay y El Cairo.
getting_in.quote: As of July 2024, Sanaa Airport has flights from Amman, Mumbai, and Cairo.

getting_in.en: Yemenia runs a skeleton service based in Aden with flights from Amman, Cairo and Riyadh.
getting_in.es: Yemenia opera un servicio mínimo desde Adén con vuelos desde Amán, El Cairo y Riad.
getting_in.quote: Yemenia runs a skeleton service based in Aden with flights from Amman, Cairo and Riyadh.

getting_in.en: There are passenger ferries from Djibouti.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris de pasajeros desde Yibuti.
getting_in.quote: There are passenger ferries from Djibouti.

getting_in.en: The Omani-Yemeni border can be crossed by car, although the border posts are often difficult to negotiate.
getting_in.es: Se puede cruzar la frontera entre Omán y Yemen en auto, aunque los puestos fronterizos suelen ser difíciles de pasar.
getting_in.quote: It is possible to cross the Omani-Yemeni border in a car, although the border posts are often difficult to negotiate.

getting_around.en: Foreign nationals need travel permits and in some regions independent travel is not possible.
getting_around.es: Los extranjeros necesitan permisos de viaje y en algunas regiones no es posible viajar de forma independiente.
getting_around.quote: foreign nationals need travel permits and, in some regions, independent travel is not possible.

getting_around.en: All travel outside the capital requires a travel permit (tasriih) from the tourist police.
getting_around.es: Todo viaje fuera de la capital requiere un permiso de viaje (tasriih) de la policía turística.
getting_around.quote: all travel outside the capital will require a travel permit (tasriih) from the tourist police

getting_around.en: The biggest bus company in Yemen is Yemitco, with offices in major cities.
getting_around.es: La mayor empresa de autobuses de Yemen es Yemitco, con oficinas en las principales ciudades.
getting_around.quote: The biggest company in Yemen is Yemitco, their offices can be found in major cities.

getting_around.en: Shared taxis do not depart until all seats are completely full.
getting_around.es: Los taxis compartidos no salen hasta que todos los asientos están ocupados.
getting_around.quote: The driver will not depart until all seats are completely full

getting_around.en: Driving in Yemen is on the right.
getting_around.es: En Yemen se conduce por la derecha.
getting_around.quote: Driving is on the right. While Yemeni drivers have something of a reputation for bad driving

getting_around.en: A 4-wheel-drive is almost mandatory because most roads away from the main city routes are not paved.
getting_around.es: Un 4x4 es casi obligatorio porque la mayoría de las carreteras fuera de las rutas entre ciudades principales no están pavimentadas.
getting_around.quote: a 4-wheel-drive is almost mandatory as most roads away from the routes connecting main cities are not paved.

money.en: There are not many ATMs outside Sana'a, and US dollars in cash is the most easily convertible currency.
money.es: Hay pocos cajeros fuera de Saná y los dólares estadounidenses en efectivo son la moneda más fácil de convertir.
money.quote: There are not many ATMs outside of Sana’a. US dollars in cash is the most easily convertible currency.

money.en: The currency is the Yemeni rial (YER).
money.es: La moneda es el rial yemení (YER).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Yemeni rial (YER or ﷼).

money.en: Bargaining, even with village children, is expected and worthwhile.
money.es: Regatear, incluso con niños de aldeas, es lo esperado y vale la pena.
money.quote: Bargaining, even with village children, is expected and worthwhile.

money.en: The rial is subject to high inflation.
money.es: El rial está sujeto a una alta inflación.
money.quote: The rial is subject to high inflation.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan, refrain from eating, drinking, smoking and chewing in public.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán, abstente de comer, beber, fumar y masticar en público.
etiquette.quote: During Ramadan, you should refrain from eating, drinking, smoking, and chewing in public.

etiquette.en: The text says never to try to take pictures of women, even if you are a woman yourself.
etiquette.es: El texto dice que nunca se debe intentar fotografiar a mujeres, aunque seas mujer.
etiquette.quote: Don't ever, ever try to take pictures of women, even if you're a woman yourself.

etiquette.en: At religious sites, behave and dress well, as some mosques may be off-limits to non-Muslims.
etiquette.es: En sitios religiosos, compórtate y vístete bien, ya que algunas mezquitas pueden estar vedadas a no musulmanes.
etiquette.quote: When visiting sites of religious importance, behave and dress well. Some mosques may be off-limits to non-Muslims.

etiquette.en: The text advises avoiding talking about Israel.
etiquette.es: El texto aconseja evitar hablar de Israel.

etiquette.en: Do not criticise or speak badly of Islam, as Yemen has some harsh blasphemy laws.
etiquette.es: No critiques ni hables mal del islam, ya que Yemen tiene leyes de blasfemia severas.
etiquette.quote: Do not criticise or speak badly of Islam; Yemen has some harsh blasphemy laws.
